title: Fines owed
statementMd:
Charge 0.25 per day late for returned loans. List members with their total fine, rounded to 2 decimals, only members who owe something. Largest first (ties by name).

Expected columns: `name`, `fine`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Sum the late days per member.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.name, ROUND(SUM((julianday(l.return_date) - julianday(l.due_date)) * 0.25), 2) AS fine FROM loans l JOIN members m ON m.id = l.member_id WHERE l.return_date > l.due_date GROUP BY m.id, m.name ORDER BY fine DESC, m.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
